channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Lon Babby | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Lon Babby from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Gerald Green on Lon Babby
item.description:
Paul Coro:Gerald Green:

“I think they want me back as well... Actually, it was a good conversation (w/Lon Babby) so I'm a little positive about that.”

Gerald Green on Lon Babby, Apr 15, 2015. Source: Twitter @paulcoro.

item.title: Eric Gordon on Lon Babby, Lance Blanks
item.description:
Gordon said in a prepared statement.

“Mr. Sarver, Lon Babby, Lance Blanks, the front office staff and Coach Gentry run a first-class organization, andI strongly feel they are the right franchise for me. Phoenix is just where my heart is now.”

Eric Gordon on Lon Babby, Lance Blanks, Jul 3, 2012. Source: Arizona Republic.
